title: Album Cover with Performer and Audience Collage
coreRelationships: The performer's back and shirt graphic are the central focus, brightly lit against a dark background.
The microphone stand acts as a strong diagonal line, guiding the eye from the bottom left towards the performer's hand.
The background is a dense, desaturated collage of faces, creating a sense of a large, indistinct crowd.
The typography is placed in the upper right, contrasting with the dark background and the performer's light shirt.
reuseFormula: Generate a stage performance scene with a male performer seen from behind, holding a microphone stand. The performer should be under a bright spotlight, wearing a light-colored short-sleeved shirt that features a large, stylized graphic of two male faces. The background must be a dark, desaturated collage of numerous indistinct audience members, creating a textured, shadowy effect. Overlay a fluid, connected white script for the main title and a smaller, all-caps white sans-serif for the secondary text in the upper right. Include a 'Parental Advisory' style graphic in the bottom left.
